title: Greek Baked Pears with Honey Yogurt
summary: Soft baked pears are drizzled with honey and served with cool Greek-style yogurt for a simple, fragrant dessert. Warm cinnamon and lemon make it feel classic and comforting.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C and lightly grease a baking dish with the olive oil.
Halve the pears lengthways and scoop out the cores with a teaspoon. Place them cut-side up in the dish.
Mix 1 tablespoon of the honey with the lemon juice, cinnamon, vanilla extract and a pinch of salt. Spoon this over the pears.
Add a small splash of water to the dish, then bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the pears are tender and lightly caramelised at the edges.
Stir the yogurt with the remaining honey until smooth.
Serve the warm pears with a spoonful of honey yogurt and scatter over the chopped walnuts.
